findings.evidence: We may automatically collect non-personal information that does not identify an individual user, such as IP (internet protocol) address, ISP (internet service provider), the Web browser used to visit the Site, the time the Site is visited, which Web pages were visited on the Site, a unique mobile device identifier (in connection with the use of the Sites or related services from mobile devices) and other anonymous Site usage data.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that the IP address and device IDs are shared with Google AdMob, nor does it deny sharing this data. It only mentions automatic collection of non-personal information.

candidates.reason: sharing IP address and device IDs with admob is covered only by unnamed recipients, unspecified purposes or generic data
